    Properties of the colimit extension (Proposition 2.3) #

    For a functor Φ : D_fin → Mod A, the extension F = Extension.functor Φ of (1.1) extends Φ (Extension.isoOfFin), is k-linear when Φ is, is faithful and exact when Φ is, and satisfies dim F(T) = dim T for infinite-dimensional T (Proposition 2.3). Additivity and colimit preservation are in Extension.Preserves.
